name: squad_rallier_offers_only_power_two_or_less_creatures
notes: M8 mapper. Printed: '{2}{W}: Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with power 2 or less from among them and put it into your hand.' The top four are Small Squire (2/2, the top card), a sorcery, a land and Big Knight (3/3); Deep Squire (1/1) is fifth. Seat 0 takes the offer and answers the pick with its first offered word: the only legal card is Small Squire, so it goes to the hand. Every card that must not be offered (the 3/3, the land, the sorcery, the fifth card) was declared before it and would come first in the pick's words.
